scripts.compliance: pnpm generate && node --test scripts/compliance/compliance.test.mjs && node scripts/compliance/cli.mjs
scripts.check-types: pnpm generate && tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p apps/web/tsconfig.json
scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm --filter @plaingym/web build && node apps/server/src/public/links/styles.build.mjs apps/web/dist && pnpm --filter @plaingym/server build
scripts.dev: pnpm generate && node apps/server/src/public/links/styles.build.mjs apps/server/public && pnpm --parallel --filter @plaingym/server --filter @plaingym/web dev
scripts.dev:up: docker compose -f compose.dev.yaml up -d --wait && pnpm db:migrate

simple-git-hooks.pre-push: if [ -f scripts/verify.mjs ]; then node scripts/verify.mjs --pre-push; else pnpm check-types && pnpm lint && pnpm test; fi
